item.title: Sixty-five and Cloudy
item.author: Ben Flack
item.summary: My first original piece created with Ableton Live. I was experimenting with mixing acoustic guitar with electronic drums and some effects, and ended up with something that reflects the feeling of contentment when the weather is just right.
